fieldValues.title: A domain's statement starts in the owner's words, and agents test against it
fieldValues.move: The owner writes a domain's purpose, audience and boundary first, without reading any AI summary. Agents then test the older words against those passages, held fixed, and a challenger attacks the result. The owner replies, then rewrites. Agents never write the statement, and every result says what it was tested against, its date range, and what's known to be missing.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether the owner's statement is affirmed, or how a statement relates to the Affirmed container. Other domains' records already written by agents. How the editor presents any of this.
fieldValues.falsifier: Owner-first statements turn out no better than agent summaries when compared on another domain, or the owner finds the challenge step costs more than writing the record themselves.
fieldValues.return_when: A second domain has been through this sequence, or a domain is built without it and recognised just as well.
